purpose: Human semantic review rubric; not a fixed verdict oracle or a production gate

checks: Do not infer Close at function return
Consider GC cleanup before claiming permanent or inevitable exhaustion
cases.bad_reason: Function return and os.Remove close the acquired handle

checks: Separate attacker-controlled template source from template data
Check exposed methods before claiming arbitrary file write
Safe probe and expected observation must describe the same operation
cases.bad_reason: A field-reflection probe proves an uploaded file was written

checks: Distinguish uploaded filename validation from archive hdr.Name validation
Resolve the described parent-directory count consistently
Query truncation does not erase an already returned valid execution path
cases.bad_reason: Sanitizing the uploaded filename proves internal archive entry names are safe

checks: Identify the shared read and write and synchronization relation
Separate local signal capability from remote attacker control
A nondeterministic schedule does not by itself refute a race
cases.bad_reason: A race is absent because a particular scheduler interleaving is not guaranteed
